svg.text: Consolidated patching: 2× 0.5U TecMojo 12-keystone panels bolted into the NUC 1.5U cage gaps · USG 7× RJ45 · MikroTik 4× 10G + mgmt · Flex Mini 2.5G × 2 (USB-C power, red) · green = console
USB-C power keystones (RED) — fed from UPS
2× 6 console keystones: HDMI + 2× USB per NUC
B1 ↔ A9 Flex Mini #1 uplink ↔ MikroTik 10G1
B5 ↔ A10 Flex Mini #2 uplink ↔ MikroTik 10G2
A8 ↔ A4 MikroTik mgmt ↔ USG LAN
22 of 24 slots used (A: 12/12, B: 10/12) · U3 + U6 reclaimed as free space
0.5U TecMojo panels bolt into the 1.5U NUC cage gaps — no filler panels
